name: Koi Sense Hai Is Baat Ki
visual_description: Two-panel stand-up comedy format showing Anubhav Singh Bassi asking 'Koi sense hai is baat ki?' in the top panel and answering 'Humein bahut lag rahi thi us time' in the bottom panel.
usage_context: Used to mock irrational or illogical decisions that seemed like a great idea in the moment.
keywords: koi sense hai is baat ki
humein bahut lag rahi thi us time

example.situation: Buying gym membership on 1st January and never going again
